_notes: UNVALIDATED STARTING HEURISTICS. Every cutoff in this file is a coach-set
heuristic, not a validated norm. They will be tuned as IMS accumulates
DynaMo / VOLTRA data. Nothing in the generator may hard-code a cutoff;
if a number matters, it lives here.
Force is normalized to bodyweight where a bodyweight is available, and to
the contralateral side always. ROM is degrees, passive unless stated.

rom_norms._comment: full_at_or_above / limited_below define the ROM axis of the quadrant. Between the two = indeterminate, no signal emitted.

force_norms._comment: bodyweight_ratio thresholds classify absolute strength when bodyweight is known. When it is not, classification falls back to asymmetry only and the quadrant is marked low_confidence.

end_range_force._comment: VOLTRA mid-range vs end-range on the same pattern. end_range_ratio = end_range_force / mid_range_force. Below weak_below = end-range weakness even when peak isometric looks fine.

asymmetry._comment: Percent difference between sides, relative to the stronger side.

weakest_link.emphasis_note: Selection bias only. Never overrides safety routing.

load_from_force._comment: Percent of measured peak isometric force used as a dynamic working load. Deliberately conservative: isometric peak substantially exceeds a safe dynamic working load for the same joint.

plausibility._comment: Any computed load outside these bounds for the exercise's equipment type is an error, not a printed number.

delta._comment: Change vs previous assessment that counts as real rather than noise.

progression._comment: Phase 2. Volume and progression individualization from age, training age and conditioning. These replace the single fixed 3x12 / 3x10 / 4x8 / 4x6 ladder that every client used to receive.

ladders._comment: Per-week [sets, reps] by profile id. Profile id = <age_band>|<training_age_band>|<conditioning>. '_default' is the legacy IMS block and is used when nothing resolves.

conservative._comment: 65+, or deconditioned at any age, or novice over 50. Lower set count, higher reps, no true peak week, RPE capped.

moderate._comment: Middle of the roster. Close to the legacy ladder but one set lighter in week 1.

aggressive._comment: Under 50, intermediate or better training age, well conditioned.

ladder_selection._comment: Scored. Points accumulate; the band the score falls into picks the ladder.

side_aware_dose._comment: Phase 3. When one side is materially weaker or more restricted, the weaker side earns extra work rather than the two sides being averaged.
side_aware_dose._applies_comment: Compounds are deliberately excluded: adding sets to one side of a bilateral compound is not coherent.
